name: recomendador-jogos
description: Descoberta de jogos de PC para um grupo de amigos (IGDB, GamerPower, IsThereAnyDeal).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @rj/api" "npm run dev -w @rj/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rj/api && npm run build -w @rj/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rj/api && npm run test -w @rj/web
